- Pronounced yellowing (chlorosis) across the leaf
- Several dark brown/black circular lesions with concentric rings (bullseye/target-spot pattern)
- Lesions scattered across the leaf surface

This strongly suggests **Early Blight** (Alternaria solani) — the concentric ring pattern in dark lesions on a yellowing leaf is the hallmark symptom. Let me confirm with one reference image.

The reference confirms Early Blight characteristics: dark lesions on leaves with associated yellowing. The test image matches perfectly — multiple dark lesions with clear concentric rings (bullseye pattern) and significant chlorosis of the leaf tissue, which are the defining signs of Early Blight caused by *Alternaria solani*.
